items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: So we picked up a piano player named Red Cayou(?) in Oakland.

ctx.x: whether we were leaving Los Angeles... Anyway, I think we went up to Oakland without a piano player, because we had a job waiting up there in a Greek restaurant and to play on a radio station. So we picked up a piano player named Red Cayou(?) in Oakland. In the meantime...
Where have I heard of him?
